hero.title: Run your salon. Let your clients book online.
hero.subtitle: Saloneo brings together your schedule, client records, team and stock, and gives your salon a booking page that stays open day and night. Built for salons in Algeria, priced in dinars, in French and Arabic.

features.title: The whole salon, in one tool
features.subtitle: No modules to piece together: what you need between two clients is already there.

agenda.title: A schedule that misses nothing
agenda.body: Every appointment has its service, its assigned team member and its status: scheduled, confirmed, completed or no-show. Saloneo won't allow overlapping time slots.
points: No-shows and appointments to close are flagged
Live updates on all your devices

booking.title: A page in your name, where clients book online
booking.body: Pick a template, your colors and your photos. Your clients see your services and prices, choose a time slot, and can change or cancel from the link they receive.
points: One link to share on Instagram, Facebook or WhatsApp
booking.alt: A salon's booking page on a phone

rest.title: And the rest of the day-to-day

clients.title: Client records
clients.body: Contact details, visit history and notes, so you can find a color formula or a regular's habits.

team.title: Team
team.body: Each team member has a role; each appointment is assigned to someone.

stock.title: Products and stock
stock.body: Your product list and quantities, kept up to date.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.body: Today's and this month's revenue, occupancy, most requested services.

mobile.title: On phone and computer
mobile.body: Designed to be used standing up, between two clients.

payment.title: Local payment
payment.body: Subscription paid by CIB or Edahabia card, through the SATIM gateway.

roi.title: How many services pay for Saloneo?
roi.body: Enter the average price of a service in your salon. The math is simple: the plan price divided by your average price.
roi.label: Average service price
roi.result: services per month cover the subscription
roi.note: Rounded up. The Free plan costs nothing.

pricing.title: Simple pricing, in dinars
pricing.subtitle: Start for free. Move to a paid plan when your salon needs it, with no commitment.

free.name: Free
free.description: To try it with a small salon.

starter.name: Starter
starter.description: For a salon with a small team.

pricing.startFree: Every account starts on the Free plan; you upgrade to Starter or Pro from the Subscription page.
pricing.payment: Payment by CIB or Edahabia card (SATIM).
pricing.enterprise: Several salons or special needs? The Enterprise plan is priced on request.

free.q: Does the Free plan need a card?
free.a: No. You create your account with an email and a password. The Free plan limits (20 appointments a month, 10 clients, 5 services) are enough to try Saloneo.

payment.q: How do I pay for a subscription?
payment.a: By CIB or Edahabia card, through the secure SATIM gateway, from the Subscription page of your account.

change.a: Yes. Upgrade whenever you like from the Subscription page. Your appointments, clients and services are kept.

limit.q: What happens if I reach a limit?
limit.a: Saloneo lets you know. Your data stays intact; to add more, simply move to the next plan.

yearly.a: You pay for twelve months at once and pay {{discount}}% less than monthly. Two- and three-year terms are also available, with a bigger discount.

data.q: Who can access my salon's data?
data.a: You and the people on your team. Traffic between your device and Saloneo is encrypted (HTTPS).

founder.title: Saloneo is just starting, with its first salons
founder.body: You won't find fake reviews or inflated numbers here: Saloneo has just opened, and we'd rather show you the product as it is.
founder.body2: If you'd like help setting up your salon — services, team, booking page — write to us. You'll get an answer from the people building Saloneo.

cta.title: Your salon can take its first online bookings today.
cta.body: Create your account, add your services, share your link.

footer.tagline: Management and online booking for beauty salons in Algeria.
